questions.question: In Pair<String,Integer>, what replaces the second formal parameter?
questions.explanation: Actual type arguments replace formal parameters by position.

questions.question: Why can a static field not have type T from class Box<T>?
options: Static state belongs to the class, while T belongs to each parameterised use
questions.explanation: There is one static field shared by Box<String>, Box<Integer>, and other uses, so no single class T exists.

questions.question: What does the diamond in new Box<>() do?
options: Lets the compiler infer type arguments from context
questions.explanation: The declared target type usually supplies the omitted constructor arguments.

questions.question: After class Box<T> is used as Box<Book>, get returns…
questions.explanation: Book consistently substitutes for T in the parameterised API.
